definitions.meaning: A whole number greater than 1 with exactly two factors, 1 and itself: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11 and so on. 1 is not prime because it has only one factor.
A whole number greater than 1 that is not prime, because it has a factor other than 1 and itself, like 9 (3 x 3) or 25 (5 x 5).
The number being multiplied repeatedly in a power: in 2^3 the base is 2.
The small raised number that counts how many copies of the base are multiplied: in 2^3 the index is 3, because 2 x 2 x 2. Also called the exponent or power.
A way of writing a number as a first factor at least 1 and less than 10, times a power of ten: 360000 = 3.6 x 10^5.

mechanismSteps: Primes under the sieve: cross out the multiples of 2, 3 and 5 but keep 2, 3 and 5 themselves - the survivors up to 25 are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 and 23.
Same base? Add the powers: 2^3 is three 2s and 2^4 is four 2s, so multiplying them lines up seven 2s and 2^3 x 2^4 = 2^7 - the indices add because the factors join.
Standard form: big numbers, small package: let the point travel left across 360000 and count five jumps, packaging it as 3.6 x 10^5.
Powers do not add when you add: work each power out first - 2^3 = 8 and 2^4 = 16 - then add the values to get 24.
objectives: Find the primes up to 25 with the sieve and explain what makes a number prime
Add the indices when multiplying powers with the same base, and never when adding
Write big numbers in standard form and convert back
subject: math
title: E-Math numbers: primes, indices and standard form

trap.explanation: The same-base index rule is for multiplying, but it gets misapplied to addition. The index rule is for multiplying, never adding: 8 + 16 = 24, not 128. In class, put the two questions side by side: multiplying joins the factors so the indices add (2^3 x 2^4 = 2^7 = 128), but adding keeps the powers separate, so work out 8 and 16 first.

workedExample: Write 360000 in standard form. The first factor must sit between 1 and 10, so place the point between the 3 and the 6 to get 3.6. Count the jumps the point made from the end of 360000: five places left. So 360000 = 3.6 x 10^5. Check back: 3.6 x 10^5 = 3.6 x 100000 = 360000.
